merged_issues.title: Missing or empty document title
merged_issues.description: The page does not contain a non-empty <title> element. A descriptive title helps screen reader users understand the page context and improves navigation (e.g., among tabs/history) and discoverability.
merged_issues.recommended_fix: Add a meaningful, non-empty <title> in the document <head>, e.g. <head><title>Descriptive page name</title>...</head>. Ensure each page has a unique title that reflects its purpose/content.

merged_issues.title: Missing main landmark
merged_issues.description: The document does not include a main landmark, which makes it harder for assistive technology users to quickly jump to the primary content region.
merged_issues.recommended_fix: Wrap the primary page content in a single <main> element (or an element with role="main"). Ensure there is only one main landmark per page and it contains the central content (not repeated navigation/footers).
